items.name: Amantha extract
items.ingredients_process: Mixed of Night vanilla, slumber flower, and chamomile, all distilled and extracted to form this aromatic floral essence.
items.description: An aromatic floral essence. Daly call it 'Amantha;' it means tranquility in the Hermes language. There is a quiet and charming fragrance, which can relax people's emotions and instantly calm as if they was gazing into the darkness of the silent night.

items.name: Bark Agent
items.ingredients_process: A mixture of bark and leaves of drago and poplar trees, which are sun-dried for seven days and decocted thrice. Then immersed them in Lanti Wine.
items.description: It toughens the user skin and muscles, rendering them as resilient as trees.

items.name: Berserk Agent
items.description: It grants the user extraordinary strength when unleashed.

items.name: Eye of the Spirit medication
items.ingredients_process: Barks and leaves of drago and poplar trees are sun-dried for seven days and decocted thrice. Then immersed them in Lanti Wine.
items.description: There is an ethereal scent of the aromatic wine, which is a good helper for psychics and a charming enough flower essence.

items.name: Goddess's Gaze
items.description: A dark red liquid. It has a certain therapeutic effect, and its main function is to stimulate the spirit and squeeze the potential of the body, so that people can maintain a good state in a short period of time and support them until they return to receive treatment.

items.name: Healing Agent
items.description: It mends most external wounds, alleviates severe injuries, and eliminates minor ailments.

items.name: Holy Night Powder
items.ingredients_process: Slumber flowers, Dragon Blood grass, deep red sandalwood, mint powder, and other herbs.
items.description: Originated from the Church of the Evernight Goddess. It can assist Beyonder to guide their own power before ritual magic, create a wall of spirituality, and build a clean and undisturbed spiritual environment around them. The limit is up to obtaining a personal silver knife or reaching Sequence 7.

items.name: Mysticism Smelling Salts (Awakening Gas)
items.description: An extremely foul-smelling gas that wakes the smeller up. It can be use to cancel or protect from the sleeping gas. It was named "Mysticism Smelling Salts" by Franca.

items.name: Quelaag's Oil
items.ingredients_process: A mix of mint and disinfectant
items.description: It could help a person ignore the stench of rotting corpses, as well as refresh and clear the mind.

items.name: Sanguine Anesthesia Gas
items.description: Cause deep slumber that lasts for more than three hours.

items.name: Sedative Agent
items.description: A blue fluid rippled in the translucent glass bottle. It made users stay awake and feel as though they had entered a mother's embrace. It was a liquid medicine that was rarely used yet was very efficient in mediumship.

items.name: Serenity Agent
items.description: Its made users maintaining clam and rationale.

items.name: Truth Serum (Confession Concoction)
items.description: A serum that make exceedingly challenging to lie. What the victims utter should stem from their innermost desires.
